initialFailure.stage: test harness configuration before browser login
initialFailure.cause: B server-init was rerun after federation-lab added its TLS listener. Saved B listeners contained only 8008 HTTP, unlike A 8008 plus 8448 TLS, so A could not connect to B.

correction: Persist B API-only mode via initializeServer before federation-lab up adds TLS; run central-init after up and reload Core without resetting Synapse listeners.
limits: Positive normal-byte round trips were independently hashed; this is not a negative test of server streaming digest rejection.
Owned Bot grants were saved/read/disabled; no Bot node or model task was started.
TLS federation used three real Synapse instances on one physical Docker host; physical cross-machine validation was not run.
